summary: Shared screen-to-world raycast helpers, so the same logic is not hand-copied at each call site.
overview: The screen-position-to-world-point logic that was otherwise being rewritten inline in several places — the grid placer, the tower placer and a couple of demo runners each had their own version. New mouse and screen-picking code should come through here rather than adding a fourth.
useCases: Turning a mouse position into a world point on a ground plane.
Picking a point under the cursor for placement or targeting.
Falling back to a mathematical plane when there is no collider to hit.

gotchas.title: The plane overload needs no collider, the raycast overload does
gotchas.body: ScreenPointToPlane intersects a mathematical plane and always succeeds. The raycast versions need something physical and can miss — pick according to whether an empty area should still give you a point.
